pre_mortem: It's Monday and both CAR at CLE legs lost. CAR WR McMillan lost because the 251 air yards were empty calories again: the CLE defense took away the middle (only 10 attempts there all season, so that 10.1 YPA is a tiny sample), CAR WR Coker and CAR TE Waller took the catchable targets, and 62.5 was the market correctly fading a two-game CAR air-yard spike rather than a floor.
